interpretation: Observed mitigation and stage recovery; no claim of a permanent network fix or measured outage rate.

checks.observed: ProjectFlow and Corporation-Agent Current each succeeded using the production Gateway, gpt-5.6-sol, OPENAI_RESPONSES, xhigh; two requests per project.
Both Current no-change runs reused the saved result with zero transport requests and zero new tokens.
A real History HTTP2_STREAM_RESET recovered with TRANSPORT_RETRY; the failed attempt retained unknown usage. The retry budget remains bounded.
The third real project retained validated Scout/tool evidence after Final Synthesis failed; recovery invoked only Final Synthesis once and completed.
Failed semantic refresh keeps the previous successful snapshot and marks it stale; detached stale updates preserve the newer checkpoint.
Wrapped Current failure reaches JobRunner with two actual requests and UNKNOWN usage, rather than a false zero.
An upstream failure without usage leaves totalTokens null/PARTIAL; reported totals contain only completed responses.
Executor timeout interrupts only its active transport request and retains normalized timeout diagnostics.
Cancellation prevents recovery requests and retains an already-entered attempt; cancellation before adapter entry remains NOT_CALLED.
Official SDK SSE accepts a completed terminal envelope; a stream ending without a terminal response cannot become successful partial JSON.
Only the explicit HTTP 200 upstream_error/stream_read_error tuple becomes a bounded transport retry; ordinary rejected requests retain HTTP status and unknown usage.
Existing active-job uniqueness, cancellation, window checkpoints, cache reuse, event conservation and read-only GET contracts passed the full backend/PostgreSQL suite.

limitations: No billing receipt: cost is UNKNOWN.
Missing upstream usage is not estimated as zero.
Mock transport tests are contract evidence, not real relay availability measurements.
Owner Review is separate and remains NOT_REVIEWED.
